title: Text Formatting and Links
description: Learn how to format text and create hyperlinks in HTML documents.

lessons.title: Text Formatting Tags Overview
lessons.content: HTML offers a variety of tags to format text including <strong>, <em>, <u>, <small>, <mark>, <sub>, and <sup>. These tags help emphasize and style content meaningfully.

lessons.title: Creating Hyperlinks with <a>
lessons.content: The `<a>` tag is used to create hyperlinks. The `href` attribute specifies the destination URL. Links can navigate to websites, pages, or even sections within the same page.

lessons.title: Best Practices for Links and Text
lessons.content: Use descriptive text for links instead of 'click here'. Always validate URLs. Use `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for external links with `target="_blank"` to improve security and performance.
